items.markdown:
You can `download and install popular browser extensions` to save your ChatGPT conversations into formats like PDF, Word, Markdown, or JSON:[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX6UUq3guKUvefABvtV_OWyzBwL0942W3392N_QWP0t-HMKe6WkeB2RCz8C2_E7Ec2-zLunHemE2IdfyXSN1ktuLOUj_IAYVModg0e0V1K6D2Nfs9srA_a4LhsT-5jUbc7WFhYVuhsPtbncvCnjmucZj31ALfhG0o)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF12j22-N9nRYPs_TWi9lmW5tONi9HKewz1fqSCZZuYsD4XJGjfIHhtISYYOrui7KMHeCT9zmn8NRmvNdIpw7s4sb13zqAmi6Vwm8_mx3-X7oUzlM_IFS0X9cDXowOL7qIPRZZbaJFNxmf7KuA-bENp5fIkP3ygTAFx07fYQ4945VLfbe6321zUfbhznKLD-y_sMw6ooM)

- **[ExportGPT](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)** : A lightweight Chrome extension that adds a sidebar interface for one-click exports to Markdown, Screenshot, PDF, HTML, and Excel.[[1]](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/exportgpt-export-chatgpt/jamcijfplmgbngnppdhmbbogjebgfimn)
- **[ChatGPT Exporter (Firefox)](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX6UUq3guKUvefABvtV_OWyzBwL0942W3392N_QWP0t-HMKe6WkeB2RCz8C2_E7Ec2-zLunHemE2IdfyXSN1ktuLOUj_IAYVModg0e0V1K6D2Nfs9srA_a4LhsT-5jUbc7WFhYVuhsPtbncvCnjmucZj31ALfhG0o)** : A local, open-source Firefox extension that saves chats as Markdown, JSON, HTML, or PDF without routing your data through an external server.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX6UUq3guKUvefABvtV_OWyzBwL0942W3392N_QWP0t-HMKe6WkeB2RCz8C2_E7Ec2-zLunHemE2IdfyXSN1ktuLOUj_IAYVModg0e0V1K6D2Nfs9srA_a4LhsT-5jUbc7WFhYVuhsPtbncvCnjmucZj31ALfhG0o)
- **[AI Exporter for ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX72-VwwuM2UjOWo9mV79vUDUxXdiGbCl6CGrVn48vKW4iovEq1Luinky0Mhs5lN7AOr8lX-_VN9RDiFf2ikQIBMidIOY1jbfjXXXr3qXzafrvyPNuvFAbBLZO2bjn3G1ik10)** : A multi-browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) rated 4.8/5 that handles large chat histories (1,000+ turns) and preserves LaTeX, tables, code, and images in PDF format.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX72-VwwuM2UjOWo9mV79vUDUxXdiGbCl6CGrVn48vKW4iovEq1Luinky0Mhs5lN7AOr8lX-_VN9RDiFf2ikQIBMidIOY1jbfjXXXr3qXzafrvyPNuvFAbBLZO2bjn3G1ik10)
- **Userscript Alternative** : If you prefer userscripts over store extensions, you can use the open-source **[ChatGPT Chat Exporter Userscript](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXJsGdYRF2qLk9PLu-xmNFu2PTVx36_MLBW-Oofqf1Ox7Hxs3OcxUWXtFC7RZCUdp5F7zMoQefksIRHTtQtfLlB5VwBvqrh5PBodzJA2ev_C0okw2tMegR-R6SPVHzWIKGuQuM-4XvgCizKRg6FWw)** from GitHub or GreasyFork to add Markdown and PDF buttons directly to your chat header or corner.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXJsGdYRF2qLk9PLu-xmNFu2PTVx36_MLBW-Oofqf1Ox7Hxs3OcxUWXtFC7RZCUdp5F7zMoQefksIRHTtQtfLlB5VwBvqrh5PBodzJA2ev_C0okw2tMegR-R6SPVHzWIKGuQuM-4XvgCizKRg6FWw)
